facts.text: I am planning to attend a costume party next weekend.
I want to dress up as a detective for the costume party.
Rachel and I had a particularly hilarious improv session today.
Rachel and I improvised a scene about a group of bumbling detectives trying to solve a murder mystery.
I like dressing up as a bumbling detective, inspired by our improv session.
I want tips on how to create a comedic detective costume that is over-the-top or exaggerated.
I want to use an oversized trench coat for my costume.
I am considering using a coat meant for a much larger person, like a plus-size coat, for the oversized trench coat.
I am considering adding fake food stains or tears to the trench coat to make it look rumpled and worn.
I am planning to add fake dirt or dust to the coat to make it look like my detective has been rummaging through crime scenes all day.
I am considering using talcum powder or cornstarch to create a dusty effect.
I am considering adding fake cigarette smoke to my costume.
I am considering using a vape pen or a fog machine to create a cloud of smoke around me.
I am planning to add props to my costume, including a fake magnifying glass and a notebook.
I am considering using a regular notebook and decorating it to look like a detective's notebook.
